remarks: Welcome to the Stella P in Legacy Ridge, Spruce Grove! This beautifully designed home offers 3 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, a spacious bonus room, and a double attached garage. The open-concept main floor features luxury vinyl plank flooring, quartz countertops, ceiling-height 41” upper cabinets, a large island, and a cozy 50” electric fireplace. The walk-through pantry and mudroom provide exceptional everyday convenience. Upstairs, enjoy a versatile bonus room, convenient laundry, and a spacious primary bedroom with dual-sink ensuite and walk-in closet. A separate side entrance, 9’ basement foundation, and bathroom rough-ins offer excellent future development potential. Located close to parks, walking trails, schools, amenities, and major routes, this home combines modern style, functionality, and room to grow! Home is under construction. Estimated completion by end of year. Photos are representative and virtually staged. (id:67522)
